title.en: Counting food — mass nouns & unit words

objective: How to ask for an amount of something that has no plural: a head of lettuce, a clove of garlic, a grain of rice. The last piece of table and market language.

grammar.point: حَبَّة, راس, قَرْن — the unit words
grammar.body: You cannot say "two lettuces". The book gives two methods and a reference table of which unit word goes with which produce — that table is the unit.
